name: Collapsing Porch OLD
description: A section of splintery and rotten floorboards drop a creature 6 feet onto uneven rocks and piercing shards of wood.
disable: DC 15 Crafting (trained) to replace or cover the weak sections of flooring, or DC 15 Survival (trained) to crumble the rotten floorboards from a safe distance
reset: Once this section of the porch has collapsed, creatures can still fall through the hole until the porch is Repaired.

generalAbilities.name: Collapse
generalAbilities.description: If a creature walks on the area marked on the map, it falls through the weakened floorboards onto uneven rocks and sharp shards of wood, taking 1d4 Piercing Damage]{1d4 piercing damage and 1d6 bludgeoning damage}. The creature can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid the fall and the damage.
